The '''aeromagnifier''' was a device used to produce a magnified image of an object.

The aeromagnifier consisted of a magnifier lens affixed to a [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsor]] hood that allowed the device to hover in place over the target object. A series of illuminator rings were arrayed around the perimeter of the magnifier.

[[Shmi Skywalker Lars/Legends|Shmi Skywalker]] was given an aeromagnifier by her slave master [[Watto/Legends|Watto]], who obtained the device in a batch of used goods. Rather than sell it on, Watto gave the aeromagnifier to Shmi, in recognition of her services as a dependable servant. Shmi kept it at her workstation in her hovel in [[Mos Espa/Legends|Mos Espa]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].
